name: AccessoryFitmentScheduler
tagline: Every dealer-fit accessory fitted, checked and ready before the car is handed over.
description: A complete dealer-fit accessory app for car dealers: accessory orders per deal, parts status and ETA, bay fitment slots with opening hours, clash and capacity checks, fit-by dates before vehicle delivery with late/at-risk alerts, fitting with technicians, QC sign-off and a ready-for-handover signal per deal. Works instantly with sample data in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Fit-by date per accessory (delivery minus a working-day buffer) with late and at-risk detection
Bays × working-days schedule with load bars, clash markers, pick-slot, drag & drop and auto-schedule
Schedule rules: parts in stock, opening hours, no overlap, not after delivery, capacity warnings
Parts board: not ordered, on order/backordered, in stock, picked with ETA conflict highlighting
Deal cards with fitted x/y progress and Ready for handover
Start fitting with technician, QC checklist and QC name, rework and cancel reasons
Search, filters, grouping, bulk parts received, auto-schedule, CSV export, undo
Phone bottom bar, day chips and card layouts; tablet layout
Power Fx outputs and events (OnSelect, OnChange, OnCreate, OnSave, OnAction, OnStatusChange)
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field control)
